title: prefetch-orchestrator-and-quant-profile-wizard-tenant-defaults
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add tenant-facing prefetch orchestration, quantization profile wizard, and unit-econ dry-run CLI; safe defaults for batch/cache and telemetry hooks; rollout gated behind feature flag.
description: Motivation: Many tenants hit suboptimal unit economics due to brittle prefill/batching defaults and ad-hoc quant profiles. This PR introduces a lightweight 'Prefetch Orchestrator' that centralizes tenant prefetch policies and a 'Quant Profile Wizard' that recommends conservative quantization + runtime profiles based on sampled workload traces. Changes include: 1) new orchestrator service (prefetch/orchestrator) with feature-flagged routes and tenant-default propagation; 2) quant profile wizard CLI and REST endpoint that runs a dry-run against sampled traces to output recommended quant levels and fallbacks; 3) default safe presets for batching and KV cache sizes that prioritize latency SLOs while improving token-cost in typical webchat workloads; 4) an offline unit-econ simulator (cli) to estimate per-tenant cost delta for proposed presets; 5) telemetry hooks (metrics and events) to track prefetch hit-rate, warmed-KV cache ratio, and quant-induced token throughput changes. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated on tenant, demo to 3 pilot tenants, collect econ telemetry for 2 weeks, then staged enable. Related: ENG-1872 (prefetch spec), ENG-1910 (unit-econ CLI).

feat: implement quant profile wizard evaluation path
feat: CLI: unit-econ dry-run and export
chore: add telemetry metrics and schema
test: e2e for orchestrator+wizard on sample traces
docs: add operator guide and runbook
review_comments: Ryan Holt: Overall looks good; main concern is safety when quant profiles are applied to latency-sensitive tenants. Please add an explicit fast-fallback that disables quantization if tail-latency exceeds threshold.
Maya Chen: Added a fast-fallback path; quant application is now gated by a runtime check and a tenant opt-in flag. Documented in operator guide.
Priya Narang: Can we ensure prefetching respects Dedicated tenant isolation? Suggest adding a routing-level guard so Dedicated traffic is excluded from prefetch warmers unless explicitly enabled.
Maya Chen: Added routing guard and added e2e test to assert Dedicated tenants see no prefetch warm-up by default.
Evan Brooks: CI flakes on warmup timing in the e2e test; recommend increasing test clock tolerance rather than changing production timeouts.
Maya Chen: Adjusted test timeouts and added a mockable clock for warmup steps.
Ryan Holt: Approved and leaving a comment about watching the new metrics for first 2 weeks post-rollout.
merge_summary: Squash+merged into main after approvals and green CI. Feature gated behind 'prefetch_orchestrator' flag. Pilot rollout to 3 tenants scheduled; followup tasks created for dashboard alerts and cost-analysis job.
notes_for_ops: Ensure feature flag flipped only for pilot tenants. Add alert on prefetched_kv_hit_rate < 0.2 or quant_applied_tail_latency_p95 increase > 15%. Schedule unit-econ job to run weekly during pilot.
guidance: Operator guide included in docs/operator; run the CLI dry-run with --sample-size=1000 to generate recommended quant/tuning presets. Use the provided report_formatter to compare baseline vs proposed token-cost. If tails worsen, the orchestrator will auto-disable quant for that tenant.
manual_test_steps: 1) Enable feature flag for tenant: curl -X POST /feature-flags -d '{"tenant":"tenant-123","flag":"prefetch_orchestrator","enable":true}'
2) Upload sample trace: cli unit-econ --upload trace.json --tenant tenant-123
3) Run quant wizard dry-run: tools/quant-wizard/runner.py --tenant tenant-123 --out recommended.json
4) Apply presets to staging by posting recommended.json to /prefetch/configs
changelog_entry: prefetch: add orchestrator; tools: quant profile wizard; cli: unit-econ dry-run; defaults: safe batching/cache presets; metrics: prefetch and quant telemetry
ci_notes: A couple of integration test runs required retries due to test clock flakiness; introduced mock clock to stabilize. All CI checks passed on final run.
risk_assessment: Medium: changes touch runtime code paths and quantization application. Mitigations: feature-flag gating, tenant opt-in, fast-fallback on tail latency, and conservative default presets. E2E tests and pilot rollout planned.
